run_write_top_k_vasp_cli: run the write_top_k_vasp script with --cache, --outdir, and --k args to generate VASP input files
generate_vasp_input_files: generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a sorted pickle cache
write_vasp_relaxation_inputs: write VASP relaxation input files using --nsw 2000 and --nelm 60 for geometry optimization runs
write_vasp_single_point_inputs: write VASP single point input files using --sp flag with --nsw 0 and --nelm 300
export_top_k_cache: export the top k configurations per system to a top_k_cache_sorted_byE.pkl file alongside paths_list.txt
